purpose: Fail-closed pre-create admission for a zero-cost candidate host using provider-appropriate billing evidence. Passing this policy does not authorize resource creation and does not prove persistent-host eligibility.

oracle_cloud.billing_evidence_rule: OCI create-instance Estimated cost may show list price and explicitly exclude tier unit pricing. Admission therefore uses independently verified Always Free entitlements rather than requiring the raw preview to equal zero.
launch_time_gate: Attempt may fail closed with out-of-host-capacity; no fallback to paid shape is permitted.
Physical host capacity is not a pre-create fact and must be observed during the authorized launch attempt.
Observe the real right-sized workload against Oracle's documented idle-reclamation conditions.
Do not generate synthetic CPU/network/memory load merely to avoid reclamation.

google_cloud.billing_evidence_rule: Google fallback retains an explicit zero-cost preview requirement because its free path depends on exact network/resource selection and external IPv4 is not admitted.

result_semantics.admitted: Configuration is safe to request separate host-creation authority.
result_semantics.not_authorized: Admission never creates a resource or grants spend, Explorer binding, LIVE, consensus, wallet, mining, or economics authority.
result_semantics.persistent_host_eligibility: Requires later real-host evidence, launch-time capacity, restart/reclaim evidence, and be06-host-preflight.mjs eligible=true.
